Representative content detail and gated playback journey.
Account signup, consent, naming/focus and error-announcement surface.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested
findings.evidence: The preferences probe found eight running animations, each with a 2,000 ms duration, while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animation and autoplay inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), preserving only necessary state feedback.

findings.summary: Route changes have no authored View Transition treatment
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found zero view-transition rules although the site exposes many full-page route changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a conservative fade and reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not respond to scroll state
findings.evidence: The recorded scroll journey retains the same large two-row header and age banner; the CSS probe found no scroll-state/container-state treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a sticky header with scroll-state-aware compacting, while keeping essential age-verification status visible.

findings.summary: Dropdown triggers lack resilient CSS anchor positioning
findings.evidence: Top navigation exposes multiple menu triggers, but the CSS probe found no anchor-name, position-anchor or position-try rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for menus and tooltips near viewport edges.

findings.summary: A consent dialog obscures the primary content on first load
findings.evidence: Desktop entry, signup and 404 captures all show a centered cookie modal covering the core page. Reject is available, but there is no light dismiss and the interruption repeats in fresh sessions.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer a compact, non-obscuring consent surface where legally permissible; retain equally prominent Accept and Reject controls.

findings.summary: Modal UI is built from generic divs instead of the native dialog primitive
findings.evidence: The signup DOM probe reports DIV role=dialog aria-modal=true rather than a dialog element, adding custom focus and dismissal risk.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement modal flows with <dialog> and showModal()/close(), including an explicit close action and correct initial focus.

findings.summary: Dense persistent chrome competes with the content
findings.evidence: The entry viewport contains a two-row global header, age-verification banner, full category sidebar and consent modal before the feed can be used.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary taxonomy navigation behind a responsive disclosure and reserve persistent chrome for primary actions.

findings.summary: The desktop layout is clipped at a 360 px viewport
findings.evidence: Across home, categories, category, video and signup, layout evidence reports a 1,024 px layout/scroll width against a 360 px visual viewport, 664 px overflow; screenshots show content and primary controls cut off.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the mobile layout based on CSS viewport, remove fixed 1,024 px constraints, and verify at 320–400 px with no horizontal clipping.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their available container
findings.evidence: The modern CSS probe found logical properties but no @container/container-type rules; cards, header and player retain desktop geometry in narrow captures.
findings.suggestedFix: Define container contexts for header, feed and player modules and adapt card columns/actions with size container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and touch targets are undersized
findings.evidence: Computed focus probes show outline-style none and no box shadow for search, Login, Get started, Accept and Reject; Lighthouse also fails target-size. Several navigation targets are 30–32 px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and make interactive targets at least 44 CSS px or provide equivalent spacing.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is outside the good Core Web Vitals range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 2.7 s and FCP 2.4 s on its mobile profile; the independent desktop trace was faster at 1.50 s, so the issue is condition-specific rather than universal.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP thumbnail/content, reduce critical CSS and delay non-essential scripts until after primary content.

findings.summary: Load performs observable long main-thread tasks
findings.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, longest 145.92 ms, with 107.01 ms total blocking time; mobile layout captures also saw tasks up to 205 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Break initialization into scheduler.yield()/postTask chunks and defer recommendation, advertising and non-visible widget work.

findings.summary: The initial dependency graph is broad and script-heavy
findings.evidence: HAR captured 145 requests and 1.69 MB transferred, including 62 scripts/997 KB and three VeryHigh parser-inserted stylesheets. Script tags are deferred, but CSS and dependency breadth remain costly.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only minimal critical CSS, consolidate styles, and conditionally load below-fold/feed integrations after core content.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused CSS and JavaScript
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 56 KiB unused CSS and 26 KiB unused JavaScript; HAR identifies a single 400 KiB index bundle.
findings.suggestedFix: Use route/widget-level code splitting and CSS coverage to remove unused selectors and avoid loading inactive integrations.

findings.summary: Some controls do not expose reliable accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails button-name and label-content-name-mismatch on the entry page; the image audit also found one image without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every icon button a stable accessible name matching its visible label and add meaningful alt text or alt="" for decoration.

findings.summary: Text and links fail minimum contrast/identification checks
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails color-contrast and link-in-text-block on the home page and color-contrast on signup.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust design tokens to meet WCAG contrast and distinguish inline links with an underline or another non-colour cue.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus indication is absent on primary controls
findings.evidence: Focus probes show no outline or focus shadow on search, login, age verification and consent buttons; Lighthouse also reports a malformed accessibility tree.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic controls, restore :focus-visible styles, and test logical Tab order and modal focus trapping with a keyboard and screen reader.

findings.summary: Narrow-screen clipping makes headings and actions unreadable
findings.evidence: At 360 px the home heading, age banner and video title/player prompt extend beyond the captured viewport, hiding text and controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow headings/actions to wrap, use minmax()/clamp() fluid sizing, and constrain content to the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Viewport scaling and reflow do not meet inclusive mobile expectations
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport because user scaling is restricted in its received mobile document, and target-size fails; independent 360 px captures show 664 px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not set user-scalable=no or a restrictive maximum-scale on any served variant; support 400% zoom/reflow and 44 px targets.

findings.summary: Most content images omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: The image audit found 29 of 36 images without width/height attributes and 13 rendered at less than half natural width. Doctype, UTF-8 and aspect-ratio checks otherwise pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height (or an equivalent stable aspect-ratio) and request responsive image candidates close to rendered size.

findings.summary: The public pages are crawlable but not mobile-friendly
findings.evidence: Links have real hrefs and robots permits the audited routes, but 360 px evidence shows 664 px overflow and Lighthouse flags the viewport policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep crawlable links while fixing the responsive viewport and removing scaling restrictions.

findings.guidanceId: canonical hreflang http status robots sitemap noindex seo indexing
findings.summary: Localized variants lack hreflang and no sitemap was discoverable
findings.evidence: The home DOM lists a canonical but zero hreflang links despite dozens of language subdomains; /sitemap.xml returned 404 and robots.txt declares no sitemap.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish hreflang clusters (including x-default) and a sitemap index referenced from robots.txt.

findings.guidanceId: structured data schema.org json-ld open graph social preview metadata
findings.summary: Video detail pages omit structured VideoObject data
findings.evidence: The representative video has useful Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD block, limiting rich entity understanding.
findings.suggestedFix: Add schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the visible title, thumbnail, creator, duration and availability.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but CSP and cookie protection are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS/HSTS, but CSP only declares frame-ancestors. Cookie evidence reports three cookies without Secure and two SameSite=None cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on all HTTPS cookies, avoid SameSite=None unless cross-site use is required, and deploy a nonce/hash-based script/style CSP in report-only then enforcement mode.

findings.summary: Third-party and recommendation traffic dominates the initial load
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 116 of 145 requests and 1.58 of 1.69 MB to other origins, including Google identity and advertising/media origins; recommendation requests include session and experiment identifiers.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential third parties on consent, proxy or self-host essential assets where possible, and minimise/batch recommendation and analytics payloads.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defenses are missing or too narrow
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no X-Content-Type-Options and no HTTP Referrer-Policy; the document itself requests unsafe-url, and Permissions-Policy only configures UA client hints. HSTS max-age is one day.
findings.suggestedFix: Add nosniff, a strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter) referrer policy, a deny-by-default Permissions-Policy, and lengthen HSTS after operational validation.

findings.summary: The video detail loses key identity in raw HTML
findings.evidence: Discoverability found only 70% content overlap on the video detail and reports that its rendered title and H1 are absent from raw HTML, although the page is not an empty JS shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the canonical title/H1 and essential age-gated player explanation so the route remains meaningful without JavaScript.

findings.summary: Signup error-announcement plumbing is present but empty during the attempted empty submission
findings.evidence: After rejecting optional cookies and activating email signup, the probe found an assertive aria-live region with no message and no invalid controls after the empty submit attempt.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure required fields use native constraints/:user-invalid and place concise field errors in the assertive live region after submission or blur.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and misses stable sizing
findings.evidence: Image evidence found 13 oversized images, 15 legacy-format URLs, 29 missing dimensions and eight below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate width-matched AVIF/WebP srcset candidates, lazy-load below-fold media and include dimensions.

findings.summary: Substantial non-core work starts during initial load
findings.evidence: HAR records 62 scripts and recommendation/advertising requests during load, while the trace records long tasks and 107 ms blocking time.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay recommendations, ads and optional account integrations until consent, visibility or user intent; batch background work.

findings.summary: Third-party transfer cost is disproportionate before playback
findings.evidence: Third-party origins account for 1.58 MB and 116 requests before a user plays media; nearly 1 MB is JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, conditionally import integrations and load media/ad widgets only when near the viewport or requested.

findings.summary: Repeated feed traversal retains materially more heap
findings.evidence: After ten bottom/top feed traversals and garbage collection, the heap summary rose from 680,958 to 791,605 nodes and 36.21 MB to 41.80 MB (+15.4%). Fresh-browser variance limits certainty, but growth warrants profiling.
findings.suggestedFix: Repeat baseline/target/final snapshots in one session, trace retainers for arrays/closures/native nodes, and release observers/listeners and feed caches after traversal.

findings.summary: The gated listing has a large initial heap footprint
findings.evidence: After garbage collection the baseline summary contains 680,958 heap nodes, 94,281 closures and 36.21 MB self size while the DOM probe reports only 1,813 elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce framework/widget initialization on the gated first view and lazy-initialise below-fold feed, identity and ad modules.
